cmd cargo-hive hidden=false about=Some("Cargo build artifacts across worktrees, with measured receipts") long_about=None
  long_help_render:
Cargo build artifacts across worktrees, with measured receipts

Usage: cargo hive <COMMAND>

Commands:
  repo     Manage registered repositories
  status   Show checkouts and Cargo target dirs of registered repos
  doctor   Check which hive capabilities work on this machine
  gc       Delete superseded incremental sessions and leftover rustc temp dirs. A session with a lock file is deleted under that lock. With no repo argument, also evicts from the store
  apply    Delete the dead units recorded in one stored plan
  seed     Fill the store from one registered repository and clone registry units into a checkout
  bench    Time cold and seeded first builds of fresh checkouts
  explain  Report copies of one crate, feature splits, and units whose last compile failed
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version

  cmd __hold-lock hidden=true about=Some("Hold a lock until killed (used by doctor's lock check)") long_about=None
    arg kind long=None short=None hidden=false required=true defaults=[] help=None long_help=None
    arg path long=None short=None hidden=false required=true defaults=[] help=None long_help=None
    long_help_render:
Hold a lock until killed (used by doctor's lock check)

Usage: __hold-lock <KIND> <PATH>

Arguments:
  <KIND>
          

  <PATH>
          

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

  cmd __try-lock hidden=true about=Some("Try a lock once without waiting and print `acquired` or `refused` (doctor's lock check)") long_about=None
    arg kind long=None short=None hidden=false required=true defaults=[] help=None long_help=None

  cmd apply hidden=false about=Some("Delete the dead units recorded in one stored plan") long_about=None
    arg id long=None short=None hidden=false required=true defaults=[] help=Some("Id of the plan to apply") long_help=None
    arg json long=Some("json") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)") long_help=None
    long_help_render:
Delete the dead units recorded in one stored plan

Usage: apply [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>
          Id of the plan to apply

Options:
      --json
          Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  cmd bench hidden=false about=Some("Time cold and seeded first builds of fresh checkouts") long_about=None
    arg build_cmd long=Some("build-cmd") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=["build"] help=Some("Compile-only cargo shape for the timed build") long_help=None
    arg cold long=Some("cold") short=None hidden=false required=true defaults=[] help=Some("Fresh checkouts measured without seeding") long_help=None
    arg json long=Some("json") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)") long_help=None
    arg seeded long=Some("seeded") short=None hidden=false required=true defaults=[] help=Some("Fresh checkouts measured after seeding from the store") long_help=None
    long_help_render:
Time cold and seeded first builds of fresh checkouts

Usage: bench [OPTIONS] --cold <COLD>... --seeded <SEEDED>...

Options:
      --cold <COLD>...
          Fresh checkouts measured without seeding

      --seeded <SEEDED>...
          Fresh checkouts measured after seeding from the store

      --build-cmd <BUILD_CMD>
          Compile-only cargo shape for the timed build
          
          [default: build]

      --json
          Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  cmd doctor hidden=false about=Some("Check which hive capabilities work on this machine") long_about=None

  cmd explain hidden=false about=Some("Report copies of one crate, feature splits, and units whose last compile failed") long_about=None
    arg json long=Some("json") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)") long_help=None
    arg repos long=None short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Registered repos to explain; none means every registered repo") long_help=None
    arg top long=Some("top") short=Some('n') hidden=false required=false defaults=["10"] help=Some("How many copy groups and divergences to show; 0 shows all") long_help=None
    long_help_render:
Report copies of one crate, feature splits, and units whose last compile failed

Usage: explain [OPTIONS] [REPOS]...

Arguments:
  [REPOS]...
          Registered repos to explain; none means every registered repo

Options:
  -n, --top <TOP>
          How many copy groups and divergences to show; 0 shows all
          
          [default: 10]

      --json
          Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  cmd gc hidden=false about=Some("Delete superseded incremental sessions and leftover rustc temp dirs. A session with a lock file is deleted under that lock. With no repo argument, also evicts from the store") long_about=None
    arg dry_run long=Some("dry-run") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Report what would be deleted and freed, deleting nothing") long_help=None
    arg json long=Some("json") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)") long_help=None
    arg plan long=Some("plan") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Store a plan of dead-unit paths and delete nothing") long_help=None
    arg repos long=None short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Registered repos to clean; none means every target hive knows") long_help=None
    long_help_render:
Delete superseded incremental sessions and leftover rustc temp dirs. A session with a lock file is deleted under that lock. With no repo argument, also evicts from the store

Usage: gc [OPTIONS] [REPOS]...

Arguments:
  [REPOS]...
          Registered repos to clean; none means every target hive knows

Options:
      --dry-run
          Report what would be deleted and freed, deleting nothing

      --plan
          Store a plan of dead-unit paths and delete nothing

      --json
          Print exactly one JSON receipt on stdout (prose goes to stderr)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  cmd repo hidden=false about=Some("Manage registered repositories") long_about=None
    long_help_render:
Manage registered repositories

Usage: repo <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Register a repository by its main checkout (any path inside it)
  list    List registered repositories
  remove  Unregister repositories (any path inside a main checkout, which may be gone)
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

    cmd add hidden=false about=Some("Register a repository by its main checkout (any path inside it)") long_about=None

      long_help_render:

      arg missing long=Some("missing") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Also remove every repository whose main checkout no longer exists") long_help=None
      arg paths long=None short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=None long_help=None

    arg no_sizes long=Some("no-sizes") short=None hidden=false required=false defaults=[] help=Some("Skip size accounting (sizes are then reported as not measured)") long_help=None

  [REPOS]...

          Skip size accounting (sizes are then reported as not measured)
